content.text: Here is your render. The first image has one still every beat (15 frames), left to right and top to bottom, starting at frame 0 and ending on the last frame. The second image shows each scene focus frame with every text role at its maximum length.

Review it as a motion director. List what is cluttered, off the beat, overlapping, cut off, hard to read, empty for too long, or banned by the style guide. Then fix all of it. Reply in the same format with the full files.
